subject: What Changed to Your Credit Card Today? Edition 3
summary: Kotak Solitaire adds a fourth add-on card slot, IndusInd's Crest trades an ITC membership for golf perks and a new lounge spend gate, and ICICI raises the Amazon Pay Card's salaried income bar to ₹30,000/month.

items.summary: Add-on card limit raised from 3 to 4 per primary card.
Complimentary ITC Hotels membership discontinued, golf benefit improved to 2 games and 2 lessons a month, and a new spend-tracking gate on domestic lounge access starts April 2026.
Minimum salaried income requirement raised from ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per month for new applicants.

subject: Banks Silently Changed These Rewards on This Credit Card
summary: ICICI drops its lounge-access spend threshold, HSBC adds a capped Amazon offer, and Equitas opens a 1:1 voucher redemption.

items.summary: Domestic lounge access is now unlimited and immediate, the old ₹75,000-a-quarter spend threshold and one-quarter wait are gone.
New offer: 20% off at Amazon, capped at ₹5,000, on ₹10,000 or more spent in a single month.
Reward points can now be redeemed 1:1 for e-gift vouchers from Apple, Tanishq, Taj Hotels, Marks & Spencer, and The Body Shop.
